Team / Sarah —

Attached is a filtered export (pipeline_rows_q4.csv) for the Evergreen deal cluster under RWI-3492. Finance flagged ~9 rows that are missing either a committed ARR amount, a mapped SKU, or a clear next step and probability. We want to lock these fields before tomorrow's forecast cutoff.

Ask: please review the rows you own and update the CRM / the sheet linked below by EOD Monday (Nov 9):
- Confirm ARR amount (if variable, put best estimate + range in notes)
- Map product to Redwood SKU (we've suggested mappings in column H)
- Set a single next step and a probability (no ranges)

Quick checklist in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example
Attachment: pipeline_rows_q4.csv (csv) — includes row owner and last activity timestamp.

If you need Evergreen to confirm product lines, Sarah is looped. Finance is expecting a firm commit mark by Nov 10 so we don't carry overstated ARR into the quarter.

Thanks — short updates please (1–2 lines per row).

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
